conventions.WPSR: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report (Topstep: 'Crude Oil Inventories (EIA) 9:30 AM / 10:00 AM* CT'). Standard Wednesday 10:30 America/New_York; holiday weeks use EIA's holiday release schedule (day and time as published in the schedule capture in force on or before the release date). Date from each issue's archive page ('Data for week ending ... | Release Date: ...').
conventions.NGS: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report (Topstep: 'Natural Gas Inventories (EIA) 9:30 AM CT'). Wayback (the only archive of the per-week WNGSR page) refused connections from about 14:00 PDT onward, so per lead ruling the entries use EIA's own pages: evidence_class holiday_schedule_row (EIA WNGSR holiday schedule, 2025-2026 rows; verified), eia_notice (EIA announcement in the NGWU; verified), standing_rule_ngwu_corroborated (Thursday 10:30 ET from the quoted standing rule, [unverified]; the EIA Natural Gas Weekly Update dated that Thursday already reports the week's storage figure), standing_rule_only ([unverified]; no NGWU that week or NGWU discontinued after 2026-01-22), inferred_thursday_holiday_shift ([unverified]; normal Thursday was a federal holiday, entered as Wednesday 12:00 ET per EIA's published practice for Thursday holidays, analog row quoted). ngs_weeks_without_a_saved_page lists the weeks with no WNGSR page.
conventions.CROP: USDA NASS Crop Production (Topstep: 'Crop Production 11:00 AM CT'), 12:00 America/New_York, from the NASS Agricultural Statistics Board calendar (monthly list view; date header, time, status 'Published'); ESMIS listing date as cross-check.
conventions.CROP_ANNUAL: USDA NASS Crop Production Annual Summary (NASS calendar label 'Crop Production - Ann.' / 'Crop Production Annual Summary'); included per the brief because NASS titles it Crop Production; always the same instant as the January Crop Production. Consumers that want one row per instant should drop it or collapse by instant_utc.
conventions.WASDE: USDA WAOB World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (lead scope addition), 12:00 America/New_York. Date from the ESMIS WASDE release page ('Release date ...'); time from USDA's WASDE FAQ ('released at 12:00 noon Eastern time') and, where saved, the USDA WASDE page's list of release dates for the year. Shares its instant with Crop Production in every month in range; kept as its own entry.
conventions.dates: the date actually published; moved releases carry the published date; delayed weekly data published together with a later week are one release instant (one entry) and are listed under moves
conventions.tz: all instants America/New_York local time converted to UTC with zoneinfo
